value.rationale: Conic and polynomial reach are mathematically motivated descriptors of nonconvex geometry and geometric estimation. A natural four-length orthogonal L family exhibits two provably distinct sharp reach scales, a codimension-one doubled cubic onset, and an unbounded ratio despite fixed connected topology. These are precise, reusable geometric boundary facts, not mere numerical tests or generic Steiner expansions.
